'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Quirin Fürgut DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Quirin Fürgut]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Quirin Fürgut]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V)|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Readiness (V) Furgut DS 2017.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014231/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
